messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 — elevated 502/504s observed at the API ingress (high fanout) across multiple edge POPs. Alert: api-gw-proxy > 1.8% 5xx in last 3m. Paging kia (oncall).

kia (oncall): seeing it, joining. Any customer-facing alerts live? :eyes:

sage (support): not yet pushed. CS flagged a handful of timed-out customer requests in EU. No broad support queue spike yet.

kia (oncall): timeline — I’ll grab the room. Alex, can you verify upstream health (nats/nginx/nlb)?

alex (infra): on it. Quick check: health of upstream pools looks ok but we’re seeing connection resets from edge proxies to app pool-2. Running `kubectl get pods -n api | grep pool-2` and `curl -I http://pool-2-internal/health` now.

maria (sre): logs show `502: upstream reset` and `504: context deadline exceeded` around the same time. Sample tail from proxy logs: ```
[2026-03-15T02:10:12Z] proxy=api-gw-12 src=10.4.1.2 "GET /v1/complete" status=502 len=512 rt=0.234 upstream_rt=0.000 upstream=reset
```

jordan (platform): frequency looks correlated with large fanout requests (clients that hit multiple downstream services per request). Could be connection pool exhaustion on pool-2.

kia (oncall): mitigation options: 1) enable aggressive circuit-breaker for fanout routes (drop secondary downstream calls), 2) throttle ingress at the proxy (rate-limit by route), 3) route traffic to fallback pool-1. Preferences?

alex (infra): immediate: flip circuit-breaker to fail-fast for non-essential downstreams. I can also temporarily reduce max connections to avoid head-of-line blocking. Doing `proxyctl set-cb /v1/complete --fail-fast=true` now.

maria (sre): +1 for fail-fast. Also increase keepalive pool size on pool-1 and route a small percentage of traffic there as canary. `route-rollout 5% pool-1`?

jordan (platform): I can push a canary route for 5% via the routing API. Starting now. Will monitor error rate and latency.

kia (oncall): sage, prep a short customer note in case impact widens. Mention degraded responses for multi-call endpoints, working on mitigation.

sage (support): drafting: "We're investigating elevated 5xx rates for multi-step API calls, intermittent timeouts — mitigation in progress." Share draft in 10m.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by jordan: routing-rollout pool-1 5% -> in_progress

maria (sre): after CB flip, proxy logs show immediate drop in upstream_rt spikes but still some 502s from existing connections. Looks like queued connections are draining.

alex (infra): also increased the HTTP keepalive pool to 200 for pool-1, adjusted nginx worker_connections to 16k on pool-1 nodes.

kia (oncall): status?

jordan (platform): 5% routed to pool-1, error rate on overall ingress dropped from 1.8% -> 0.9% in 2m. Latency slightly up for canary but acceptable.

sage (support): support queue has two customers reporting intermittent errors, both via EU. No major tickets yet.

maria (sre): I’m seeing 502s trending down but we still have regional spikes in eu-west-1 POPs — likely due to local backend saturation. Can we shift EU traffic regionally to avoid the hot POP?

alex (infra): we can toggle regional routing to prefer eu-central edges for a short window. Doing `route-migrate region eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 prefer` as a temporary measure.

kia (oncall): proceed. Keep in mind sessions — check sticky session behavior.

jordan (platform): migration started. Observability: tracing shows reduced retries and upstream resets for migrated traffic.

maria (sre): error rate eu-west-1 down 30% after migration. Overall ingress 5xx now 0.4% and stable for 5m.

kia (oncall): good. Actions summary: CB fail-fast enabled, 5% canary to pool-1, keepalive & worker tunings applied, regional migration for eu traffic. Moving to recovery watch.

sage (support): customer note ready if we need it. Holding until we confirm <0.5% sustained.

alex (infra): opening a follow-up ticket to investigate connection resets root cause (probably connection exhaustion + retry amplification). Will include pool-2 pod metrics and TCP retrans stats.

maria (sre): postmortem owners: infra (alex) for capacity/tuning, platform (jordan) for routing & rollouts, SRE (maria) for CB and observability.

kia (oncall): handing back to on-call rotation stable. If error rate creeps above 0.8% re-pager. Closing this thread in 15m if stable. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident annotated: tags=[ingress, 5xx, fanout, mitigation], severity=SEV2 -> monitoring.

jordan (platform): quick note — recommend a follow-up: add per-route fanout guards to avoid cascade in the future and a small steady-state backlog drain capability.

alex (infra): agreed. I'll also add connection pool auto-scaling to the infra backlog.

kia (oncall): thanks team. I’ll post the short timeline & immediate mitigations to #postmortems once we confirm closure.

sage (support): posting the customer-facing blurb to the comms channel now (internal draft).

maria (sre): final check - 20m with <0.5% — marking mitigated. Will attach logs and key graphs to the postmortem.

kia (oncall): thread closed for mitigation, but postmortem/owners noted. Great job. :tada:
